quests.title: Shifting Moonlight

dialogue.t: Wow, it's so lively here today! All those kuuhenki are dancing around Columbina!
Uh, wait a sec... That's not dancing. Looks more like they're trying to... bury her alive in a pile of cuteness!
H—Help me...
Phew... Thank you...
Why were the kuuhenki acting like that just now...? They're not usually that energetic, are they?
Well...
I decided to play a game with the little ones, and it seems they became quite invested...
Crowding around you like that after playtime... Kinda like puppies, aren't they?

dialogue.sit: Maybe that's their way of showing gratitude.

dialogue.t: Mm... Only this time, their gratitude felt more like getting caught in an unexpected snow drift...
You say that, but Paimon bets you never pass up a chance to spoil them!
In any case, would the two of you like to give it a try?

dialogue.sit: You mean... being surrounded like that?
You mean... playing a game with the kuuhenki?

dialogue.t: Hm... That can be arranged. You just need to get the right answer.
Oh, sure thing. It'll be cool to see what sort of game's got the kuuhenki so obsessed.
Go on now.
If you'd like, you're more than welcome to play with the kuuhenki again sometime.
All you need to do is guess the image.
Huh? B—But... it's way too abstract!
Did you actually manage to get the right answer when you played, Columbina?
No, I guessed wrong more often than not.
Huh, well Paimon's gonna quit while she's ahead... Why don't you take a guess, {NICKNAME}?

dialogue.sit: A harpoon with one prong bent backwards.

dialogue.t: Whoa, that reaction must mean...
Congratulations, your answer is correct.
Hehe, guess this means we did good?

dialogue.sit: They really are so soft and squishy.

dialogue.t: Wait, we get a reward even though we got it wrong? Huh, well... Paimon doesn't mind a consolation prize.
The kuuhenki have taken a liking to you.
I can feel it... They are at ease in your presence.
Just as Rimehorn Deer fawns are given to bathing in the moonlight, so too are the kuuhenki drawn to that which radiates from your heart.
Oh? And what would that be, exactly?
A certain kindness and gentleness, I suppose.

quests.description: The Damselette seems to be playing with kuuhenki in the Silvermoon Hall…
